info.title: Storerocket Universal API
info.description: StoreRocket is a hosted store locator platform. This app wraps the verified StoreRocket REST API for account info, project listing, and location CRUD.

projectId.description: The StoreRocket project ID that will receive the new location.

url.description: Public website URL for the location.

visible.description: Whether the location is visible in the locator.
